notes.title: Castle Crumble Demo is ready to play!
notes.content:
Finally - it's time to introduce you demo of PC version of one of our top games - Castle Crumble!
Slide into a crazy world full of views to see, creatures to meet and castles to crash!
Who is ready to crumble some castles in our fresh new demo? Cause we definitely are!

https://steamcommunity.com/broadcast/watch/76561199831726913


Demo Features:

 20 levels set in the Training Grounds biome
 A selection of weapons to experiment with different types of destruction
 Puzzle-like challenges where every shot counts
 Real-time physics-based destruction - watch rubble fly and towers fall in unexpected ways

Whether you're carefully knocking out support beams or triggering chain reactions, each level is a new chance to master the art of controlled demolition.

notes.title: Spire Blast is now live in Early Access
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45327897/f4b5ac405faf4325eb9e0c8b8f51818b4bf184d2.png
We’re beyond excited to officially announce that Spire Blast is now available on Steam Early Access! Get ready to embark on an epic, fast-paced journey through stunningly crafted environments, as you blast your way through towering spires, mysterious creatures, and intense challenges.

What’s Spire Blast?

Spire Blast is a unique blend of strategy, color match, and addictive gameplay where you’ll take control of a powerful weapon to break through colorful spires. With your trusty arsenal of explosive gadgets, you’ll aim, fire, and smash your way through multiple levels, unlocking new abilities and powerful upgrades along the way.

Early Access Features:
    
 Multiple Spires to Explore: Navigate through diverse and ever-challenging environments, each with its own set of hazards and enemies.
     Dynamic Combat: Shoot, dodge, and blast your way through swarms of enemies with fluid, reactive combat.
     Unique Progression System: Earn upgrades, unlock new skills, and grow stronger as you conquer the spires.
     Endless Replayability: Procedurally generated challenges keep each playthrough fresh and exciting.
     Steam Achievements & Leaderboards: Compete against friends and players worldwide to claim your spot at the top!

Why Early Access?

We’re launching Spire Blast on Early Access because we believe in building this game together with YOU, the community. Your feedback is crucial in helping us refine mechanics, balance, and content to ensure a game that you’ll love.

Throughout Early Access, expect:

     Regular updates with new content (levels, enemies, and more!)
     Bug fixes and improvements based on your feedback
     A growing community of players to connect with


Join Us on This Journey!

We can’t wait for you to dive into Spire Blast and experience all the explosive action, thrilling challenges, and the excitement of discovering new strategies. Your input will be key to shaping the final version of the game, so don’t hesitate to share your thoughts with us!

Thank you for your support, and welcome to the world of Spire Blast!
